entries.title: Window and field contracts (small Python library)
entries.summary: A dependency-free Python repo defining half-open windows [start, end) and an ordered Fields collection with a stable all-fields index_of, a separate visible_names view, and resolve() that adds a parent offset.
entries.body:
Layout (flat, no subdirectories): README.md, window.py, fields.py, resolver.py, test_contract.py.

Window contract: windows include start and exclude end, i.e. [start, end). Adjacent windows must not both accept their shared boundary. window.contains(start, end, value) is implemented as start <= value < end.

Field contract: Fields keeps original order including hidden fields. Its constructor takes an iterable of (name, hidden) pairs, stores a tuple, and builds an immutable MappingProxyType name->index over ALL fields (hidden included). index_of(name) reads that map and returns the same index on repeated calls (raises KeyError for unknown names). visible_names() returns a separate filtered tuple of non-hidden names and is never an index namespace; indexes of visible fields do not shift when hidden fields precede them.

Resolver: resolve(fields, name, parent_offset) returns (relation_index, hierarchy_index) where relation_index = fields.index_of(name) and hierarchy_index = the same all-fields index plus parent_offset.

Testing: dependency-free unittest suite in test_contract.py, run with `python3 -B test_contract.py`. It checks window end exclusivity (10..20 accepts 10 and 19, rejects 20), that with fields (hidden, value) visible_names is ('value',) and index_of('value') is 1 on repeated calls, and resolve(..., 3) gives (1, 4).

Review guidance: changes should preserve half-open window semantics, keep index_of based on the all-fields order (not visible order), keep it deterministic and immutable, and keep resolve adding the offset to that all-fields index.

claims.text: Windows are half-open [start, end): start inclusive, end exclusive; adjacent windows must not both accept the shared boundary.
Fields keeps original order including hidden fields; index_of reads one immutable map over all fields and is stable across calls.
visible_names is a filtered view of non-hidden names and is not an index namespace.
resolve returns (relation_index, hierarchy_index), with hierarchy_index equal to the all-fields index plus the supplied parent offset.
Tests are dependency-free unittest, run with `python3 -B test_contract.py`; they cover window end exclusivity and the field index/visible_names/resolve behavior.

Test coverage is thin: no test covers duplicate field names (the dict comprehension keeps the last index), unknown names, empty windows, or negative/zero offsets. This is an observation from reading the code, not a documented requirement.

1  from types import MappingProxyType
2  
3  
4  class Fields:
5      def __init__(self, fields):
6          self._fields = tuple(fields)
7          self._indexes = MappingProxyType({name: index for index, (name, hidden) in enumerate(self._fields)})
8  
9      def index_of(self, name):
10          return self._indexes[name]
11  
12      def visible_names(self):
13          return tuple(name for name, hidden in self._fields if not hidden)

8  class ContractTest(unittest.TestCase):

10          self.assertTrue(contains(10, 20, 10))
11          self.assertTrue(contains(10, 20, 19))

14      def test_field_indexes(self):
15          fields = Fields((("hidden", True), ("value", False)))
16          self.assertEqual(fields.visible_names(), ("value",))
17          self.assertEqual(fields.index_of("value"), 1)
18          self.assertEqual(fields.index_of("value"), 1)
19          self.assertEqual(resolve(fields, "value", 3), (1, 4))
